body: Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission
agenda_text:
BELMONT SHORE PARKING AND BUSINESS
  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 15, 2025
  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

Matthew Peterson, Chair  David Link, Commissioner
Jann Kronick-Gath, Vice Chair  Jodi Meade, Commissioner
Deborah Castro, Commissioner  Aaron Tofani, Commissioner
Jeffrey Cozart, Commissioner

MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS OR
  EMAIL COMMENTS TO PW-BSPBIAAC@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55273  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Belmont Shore Parking and
  Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission meeting of Thursday, April 17,
  2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55274  Recommendation to receive and file a Long Beach Public Works financial report
  discussing revenues during the period ending April 30, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55275  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Transit Employee Bus Pass
  Program Status for April 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55276  Recommendation to receive status updates on Conservation Corps of Long
  Beach’s work in the Belmont Shore area, including responses to requests for
  assistance, for April 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-55277  Recommendation to receive and file the presentation regarding Community
  Facilities District No. 2007-2 (Belmont Shore) Fiscal Year 2026 assessment rate at
  $0.14 per square foot.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   BELMONT SHORE PARKING AND BUSINESS
  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVISORY AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 15, 2025
  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

6.  25-55278  Recommendation to receive and file the 2024 Annual Report for Belmont Shore
  Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-55279  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion to increase the parking meter
  rate to $2.25 per hour, at a 3-hour maximum.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory
Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their
comments unless extended by the Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Kimberly Luna, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Kimberly Luna at Cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
